tasks.checker:
import ast
import contextlib
import io
import runpy
import sys

reference = '# 전체 방문 수를 사람 수로 나눠요.\nvisits = 7\npeople = 2\n# 평균은 소수도 남겨야 해요.\nprint(visits / people)\n'
cases = [{}, {'visits': 9, 'people': 4}, {'visits': 5, 'people': 2}]
source = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf8').read()
class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values=values
        self.seen=set()
    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets)==1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name=node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value=ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node
def execute(text, values):
    tree=ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    output=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree,'main.py','exec'),{'__name__':'__main__'})
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('\n')
for values in cases:
    expected=execute(reference,values)
    actual=execute(source,values)
    assert actual==expected, '준비 값이 바뀌었을 때도 같은 규칙으로 계산하세요.'
print('코드의 실제 실행 결과를 확인했어요.')

tasks.checker:
import ast
import contextlib
import io
import runpy
import sys

reference = '# 계산에 필요한 값을 한 기록에 묶었어요.\nrecord = {"price": 6, "count": 3}\n# 두 키의 값을 꺼내 전체 금액을 계산해요.\nprint(record["price"] * record["count"])\n'
cases = [{}, {'record': {'price': 8, 'count': 2}}, {'record': {'price': 3, 'count': 5}}]
source = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf8').read()
class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values=values
        self.seen=set()
    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets)==1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name=node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value=ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node
def execute(text, values):
    tree=ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    output=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree,'main.py','exec'),{'__name__':'__main__'})
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('\n')
for values in cases:
    expected=execute(reference,values)
    actual=execute(source,values)
    assert actual==expected, '준비 값이 바뀌었을 때도 같은 규칙으로 계산하세요.'
print('코드의 실제 실행 결과를 확인했어요.')
